2 · Background

Today it still runs on paper.

Question sets, answer sheets, Annex D, E and F, nominal rolls and feedback forms are printed, hand-marked, scanned and posted to HQ within four weeks. Personal data travels in instructors' cars and homes until it's submitted.

✕ On paper

  • 100 to 120 printed pages for a 12-learner course
  • 2 to 3 hours of instructor admin per course
  • Packs scanned, posted and chased before the four-week deadline
  • Personal data in cars, kitchens and inboxes
  • Every county does it slightly differently

✓ Digital

  • Register and theory exam on learners' own phones
  • Annex D, E and F, answer sheets and feedback built automatically
  • 31-point local IQA check before anyone can submit
  • Data in one controlled system, access by role
  • Same process, same forms, every county

6 · Pricing

Priced per instructor. Learners and cadets are free.

The standard commercial rate is £8.60 per instructor per month. ACCT UK is offered a banded rate card: each instructor is charged at the rate for the band they fall in, with lower rates for 24- and 36-month agreements. All prices exclude VAT.

£1,500 one-offInitial design and development, including set-up and online training for instructors and the IQA team
Per instructor per monthBanded by number of instructors and length of agreement (rate card below)
Pilot: freeThree months in two counties, with the IQA team reviewing every course pack through the system

How this is worked out

Rate card per instructor per month

Instructors12 months24 months36 months

Each instructor is charged at the rate for their band, so moving into a lower band does not change the rate for instructors already in earlier bands. The 36-month, 500+ rate is the lowest rate offered.

Terms

Live within 4 weeks of agreement. Licences are active instructor accounts, reviewed quarterly. Invoiced annually in advance. Prices fixed for the first 12 months, then reviewed annually, capped at CPI. Agreements run for the full term chosen; the 24- and 36-month rates apply to the whole term and early termination is only for material breach. Either party may give 3 months' notice before the end of the term; otherwise it renews for 12 months at the then-current rates.

Data

Secure cloud database with daily backups and role-based access. A data-processing agreement and DPIA support are provided, and all ACF data is returned at the end of the agreement. ICO registered; Cyber Essentials pending.

7 · Recommendation

A free pilot, then a decision.

It is recommended that ACCT UK approves a free three-month pilot in two counties, with the IQA team reviewing every course pack through the system, confirms its instructor numbers and procurement threshold, and decides on the agreement term by 28 February 2027.

Step 1Agree the pilotTwo counties chosen by ACCT UK. Data-processing agreement signed.
Step 2Go live in 4 weeksSet-up, instructor and IQA training online. Included in the £1,500.
Step 3Run every course through itEvery FAW and EFAW course in the pilot counties, packs reviewed by the IQA team.
